data.title: Keep the project *tidy*
data.subtitle: Habit 11. Big picture in, decisions saved, old files out.

blocks.text: One task's details stay in that task's chat.
Chats in a project **don't share context** on their own. Only the project knowledge reaches every chat.
Write a short note on what we settled in this chat: the decisions, the reasons, the open questions and the next step. Plain text, no more than 10 lines.

items: Save the note as a text file
Add the file: every chat can now use it
Chat outside the project? Dropdown arrow → **Add to project**
